hana: Flagging a weird batch this morning — playbook marked ~110 accounts as "stalled: invite_failed" after we migrated SSO invite flow. Many of these actually had manual onboarding events in the CRM.

zack: I saw that. Root cause looks like `invite_status=bounced` when the delivery failure is DMARC/reject at relay, but later the customer completed SSO via IdP and an LMS entry recorded onboarding. Playbook is only reading invite_status and treating bounce as final.

cs-ops-bot: playbook-run 3070012345 completed 09:03:12 flagged=112 reason=invite_bounce (:warning:)

mira: Can we treat invite_bounce as a soft-fail if there's downstream evidence (crm.manual_onboard OR lms.completion OR idp.last_login within 7d)? We shouldn't flip account health off for transient email issues.

oliver (eng): Agree. Proposed quick fix: 1) add `invite_bounce_reason` parsing and ignore bounces with reason `dmarc_reject` for 48h while we check idp logs; 2) add fallback lookup chain: idp.last_login, lms.completion_ts, crm_manual_flag. I'll open a PR for the runner.

karen: Also, some customers use company-wide email security that rewrites bounce reasons; better to treat any bounce as soft unless confirmed by `delivery_status=permanent` from relay AND no further signals for 72h.

zack: Good point. For short-term: implement `soft_bounce=true` when bounce_reason in [dmarc_reject, mailbox_disabled, relay_policy], and require absence of other signals for 72h before marking stalled.

cs-ops-bot: ticket created: CS-6119 "soft-bounce fallback + idp lookup" assigned to oliver (:ticket:)

oliver (eng): I'll push a staging patch: branch `cs/playbook/soft-bounce-idp-fallback`. PR: https://git.redwood/s/cs/playbook/+/2999. Changes include `get_fallback_signals(account_id)` that checks: idp.last_login (7d), lms.completion (14d), crm.manual_touch(30d). Needs dry-run.

leo: Can we also enrich the flagged CSV with `bounce_reason`, `idp_last_login`, `lms_completion`, `crm_manual_touch` so AMs can triage? If we re-run the playbook we should post a digest.

mira: Absolutely. Dry-run plan: sample 500 accounts from the flagged set and run with the fallback enabled but `--dry-run` so no state changes. oliver can you provide the command?

oliver (eng): Running this command in ~5m:

```
python cs_playbook/run.py --playbook invite_monitor --dry-run --sample 500 --patch soft_bounce_idp_fallback --out s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3070012345/invite_fallback.csv
```

It will produce a CSV with columns: acct_id, old_flag, new_flag, bounce_reason, idp_last_login, lms_completion, crm_manual_touch.

cs-ops-bot: dry-run queued by oliver (sample=500) (:hourglass_flowing_sand:)

hana: While dry-run runs, please pause the renewal/healthscore alerts for tag=invite-fallback so AMs aren't spammed. @karen can you pause for 2h?

karen: Done. Alerts muted until 3070013400.

zack: One more ask: add a quick detection metric to pick up spikes in 'invite_bounce' where >30% of bounces are DMARC/reject from the same relay. That could indicate domain-level security change and we'd want to route invites via alternate channel (in-product link). I'll add an item to the playbook backlog.

mira: Good idea. Also, let's prepare an AM note template explaining: "we detected invite delivery issues; we re-evaluated accounts using SSO and LMS signals and corrected statuses; no action needed unless you see a follow-up." I'll draft and attach flagged CSV after dry-run.

oliver (eng): Dry-run finished. Summary: sample=500, would_unflag=91, would_keep_flag=9. CSV: s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3070012345/invite_fallback.csv.

cs-ops-bot: dry-run 3070012345 completed (s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3070012345/invite_fallback.csv) (:white_check_mark:)

leo: Nice. That's a big reduction. Next steps: 1) merge PR to staging, run full run for affected cohort in dry-run and post CSV 2) merge to prod with 5% canary for 24h 3) re-run playbook to correct states and notify AMs with attached CSV 4) backlog item for alternate invite channel + DMARC detection.

oliver (eng): Merged to staging and queued cohort run: `./bin/score --cohort recent-invites --dry-run --patch soft_bounce_idp_fallback --out s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3070012345/full_cohort.csv` ETA ~45m.

mira: Thanks. Karen, please hold the AM note until we have the full cohort CSV. Also add `backup_reason` to AM digest so they know why accounts were unflagged.

karen: Will do. Draft ready, will attach CSV and send after confirmation.

hana: Follow-up items: oliver to add tests for idp signal lookup, zack to add DMARC spike metric, mira to own AM comms and postmortem. Assign owners in CS-6119.

cs-ops-bot: CS-6119 updated: owners={oliver,zack,mira} due=3070098800 (:spiral_calendar:)

mira: Closing loop for now. Great cross-team response — let's keep an eye on the staging run and flag if anything unexpected pops up. Thanks everyone :clap:
